text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
Wants(x, y) ::: x wants to y.
Access(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Can(x, y) ::: x can y.
Will(x, y) ::: x will y.

Premises:
Likes(george, music) → Wants(george, compose) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
Access(george, program) → Can(george, compose) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
(Can(george, compose) ∧ Wants(george, compose)) → Will(george, compose) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.

Conclusion:
¬Will(george, compose) → ¬Can(george, compose) ::: If George will not compose, George can not compose.
